title: LoginModelDTOV3
description: Login Model that provides user name and password for the Login process.

userKey.title: User Key
userKey.description: Equivalent to a personal access token. Avoid pasting as plain text where it might be compromised. For a service user (recommended), you can find the user key in the Mend SCA App in **Admin > Users**. [Learn more](https://docs.mend.io/bundle/mend_maintenance/page/managing_service_users.html). For local testing purposes, you could also use one of your own personal user keys from your user profile page in the Mend SCA App.
